items.name: meridian-base
items.title: Meridian base
items.description: The whole design-system foundation in one item: the compiled DTCG token artifact as CSS custom properties (all four colour modes), the Tailwind v4 @theme, the shared component stylesheet and the class-name helper every Meridian component imports. Every component in this registry declares it as a registry dependency.

items.name: meridian-style
items.title: Meridian styled layer
items.description: The aggregate Meridian stylesheet: imports the token artifact, the Tailwind theme, the shared component CSS, every component sheet and the reduced-motion layer, in the cascade order the authored barrel declares. Adding this item installs the base and every component in this registry.
